main.description:
Answers a pending request. For a `#drawers` request that does not name a drawer, `drawer` is
the drawer the person picks and is required unless declining; one that does name a drawer is
answered for it unless `drawer` says otherwise. An answer to a request that is not pending,
or a pick on a `#method` request, is refused.

By the time an allow or an only-this-boot answer returns, the cartridge's handles have been
re-minted from it, so the cartridge's next call sees the access.

errors.description: Staging refuses a version once its envelope has been published.
errors.name: AlreadyPublished

errors.description: A pinned datum is unavailable at its recorded frontier; this is recoverable when sync catches up.
errors.name: PinnedDatumUnreadable

errors.description: A pin must resolve inside the registry document that carries its envelope.
errors.name: PinnedDocumentMismatch

errors.description: A pinned datum was readable but did not decode as its declared manifest type.
errors.name: PinnedDatumInvalid

errors.description:
The envelope a [`ResolveCartridgePin`] pin selects is not available at its heads yet;
this is recoverable when sync catches up.
errors.name: PinnedEnvelopeUnreadable

errors.description:
The envelope a [`ResolveCartridgePin`] pin selects is not the revision the registry
serves under its label.
errors.name: PinnedRevisionMismatch

errors.description: A published version never changes content: the label is taken by another envelope.
errors.name: VersionExists

errors.description:
The envelope's signature is missing or does not verify against its namespace DID, or the
DID's method cannot be verified without resolution (fail closed).
errors.name: Signature

errors.description: An unsigned envelope can be signed by the node only for the node's own DID.
errors.name: UnsignedForeignNamespace

errors.description:
A new label must order after every label the cartridge has or had, so a validly signed older
version cannot be published as new (a downgrade attack). Taking an older version is an
explicit runtime action, not a registry one.
errors.name: Downgrade

errors.description: The handle's namespace scope does not include the cartridge's namespace.
errors.name: NamespaceNotPermitted

errors.description: The version exists in the drawer but its signature did not verify, so it is not served.
errors.name: Unverified

errors.description:
An artifact's bytes are not in the local blob store, so the registry would pin bytes it
cannot serve.
errors.name: ArtifactUnavailable
